headline: Public Storage (PSA) Completes Senior Notes Offering Tied To National Storage Deal
summary: Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has completed a major senior notes offering with detailed covenant disclosures. The notes include special mandatory redemption provisions tied to the outcome of its planned acquisition of National Storage Affiliates Trust. These terms link the company’s new debt obligations directly to the completion or non completion of the pending transaction.
